info.title: Salesforce REST API
info.description:
The Salesforce Platform REST API, together with Bulk API 2.0 and Bulk API (1.0). Covers org discovery and limits, sObject metadata and describe, single-record CRUD and external-id upsert, SOQL query and SOSL search, list views, layouts, quick actions, invocable actions, approvals and workflow rules, the composite resources (composite, batch, graph, sObject tree and sObject collections), platform event schemas, knowledge and consent, and both bulk job APIs.

The @openfn/language-salesforce adaptor reaches this API through jsforce: its named operations (create, insert, retrieve, update, upsert, destroy, describe, query) map onto the sObject and query resources, its bulk1 and bulk2 modules onto the two bulk APIs, and its http.request/get/post builders onto any resource here.
